slides.texte_overlay:
How to be charismatic
without being good-looking
Make people feel heard. Repeat back what they said in your own words. Feeling understood is rarer and more attractive than good looks.
Have opinions and share them kindly. A man with clear views, expressed with respect, is far more memorable than one who agrees with everything.
Use humour generously. Laugh at their jokes, tell your own, laugh at yourself. Fun people are magnetic whatever they look like.
Keep good posture and eye contact. Simple body language changes how people see you within seconds. Start today, it's free.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Interesting stories make people forget about looks completely.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Interesting stories make people forget about looks completely.

slides.texte_overlay: Be passionate about something. When you light up about a topic, people lean in and listen. Find yours and talk about it with real joy.
Be kind and consistent. Charisma that lasts comes from how you treat people every day, not from a first impression.
